It rewards the methodological backbone (using the Figure 5A hierarchical clustering of 121 cerebellar efferent neurons, mirroring to the right hemisphere, overlaying on the gray standard brain outline, cluster-specific color coding, omission of Purkinje cells/cluster 7 for clarity, and black rectangles marking zoomed regions) as well as the key anatomical observation (dendrites of individual eurydendroid cell clusters tile the granule cell layer) and its functional implication (segregation of inputs). rubric.GT core conclusion: Following hierarchical clustering of 121 cerebellar efferent neurons (91 eurydendroid cells and 30 Purkinje cells) based on NBLAST similarity scores (Figure 5A), all neurons were mirrored to the right hemisphere and overlaid on the outline of the standard brain (gray surface), with different colors representing the different clusters from Figure 5A; Purkinje cells (cluster 7) were omitted for clarity, and black rectangles indicate zoomed regions. This visualization reveals that the dendrites of the individual eurydendroid cell clusters tile the granule cell layer, suggesting a segregation of inputs.

Scoring items.deduction_rule: Deduct 15 points if the link to the Figure 5A clustering or the cerebellar efferent neuron population is missing. Deduct 6-10 points if the population size/cell-type distinction or the clustering reference is substantially incorrect.

Acceptable deviations: Paraphrasing 'mirrored to the right hemisphere' as 'standardized to one hemisphere' or 'projected to the right side' is acceptable if the consistent overlay on the standard brain is preserved
Referring to 'Purkinje cells' simply as 'cluster 7' (or vice versa) is acceptable, provided the omission for clarity is stated

Paraphrasing 'tile the granule cell layer' as 'spatially segregate within the granule layer', 'occupy distinct spatial territories in the granule layer', or 'non-overlapping dendritic arbors' is acceptable
Reporting approximate neuron counts or omitting the exact 91/30 breakdown is acceptable if the clustering context remains clear
Omitting the developmental stage (6 dpf) or exact coverage details is acceptable if the cerebellar efferent spatial context is preserved
Referring to colors without explicitly citing 'Figure 5A' is acceptable if the correspondence to the morphological clusters is clearly stated
Minor rephrasing of black rectangles/zoomed regions is acceptable if the spatial visualization purpose is preserved
rubric.Scoring instructions: Full credit requires capturing both the visualization strategy (Figure 5A clustering, right-hemisphere mirroring, standard brain overlay, cluster-specific colors, Purkinje cell omission, zoom rectangles) and the core scientific discovery (EC dendrites tile the granule cell layer, suggesting input segregation). Partial credit should be awarded when the answer preserves the main topographic organization or the tiling interpretation but simplifies methodological or biological details. Low scores should be assigned when the answer reduces the figure to a generic visual description (e.g., mentioning only colors and rectangles), omits the tiling in the granule cell layer, or misses the segregation-of-inputs conclusion.
